content: Melvin-Koushki reads the need to list the salaf as a concession to the unintelligent, the intellectual and spiritual elite, he implies, taking devotion to the Imams as guardians of the uncreated, all-creative letters as a given.
refers_to_primary: Ibn Turka, Mafāḥiṣ, MS Majlis 10196 ff.89b-90a (per MK fn.150)
